summary.headline: Astrological Judgments of Inceptions
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on judging inceptions: Jupiter rising in the horoscope or the Life place, testimony of benefics and malefics, planetary predominance, and angular or succedent stars reveal the beginnings, middles, and ends of affairs. It also assigns past, present, and future—and childhood, prime of life, and old age—to the setting, angular, culminating, and rising places.
